confidence_mapping.convention: higher confidence = more anomalous = more likely attack

ensemble_role.note: IF weight 0.10 implements soft-gating: IF-only false positive contributes max 0.10 to ensemble score, below the 0.50 alert threshold. Multi-engine corroboration required to trigger alert.

notes: Isolation Forest trained on BENIGN-only CICIDS2017 training split. SMOTE not applicable -- IF is unsupervised and requires no attack labels. class_weight parameter not applicable to IsolationForest. Confidence mapped to [0.0, 1.0] via sigmoid(decision_function score). Higher confidence = more anomalous flow = higher attack probability.
